quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (H1 2026 report): market demand for all three product categories (aluminum electrolytic, film and supercapacitors) was strong and capacity utilisation stayed high; traditional applications kept or raised their market share and the share of new applications rose month by month. Construction of a smart industrial park started, to give the company a production base for the major growth it says has arrived.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (H1 2026 report): in aluminum electrolytic capacitors it built new and rebuilt fully automatic snap-in production lines suited to data centers; next-generation aluminum capacitors such as solid-liquid hybrid and MLPC achieved technical upgrades and capacity is being expanded; etched-foil specific capacitance keeps rising and N-type conductive polymer material is gradually being industrialised. Film capacitors are rapidly raising production capacity to take share in niche markets where specific products perform well.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (H1 2026 report): 'the period of great development for supercapacitors has arrived' - demand in emerging applications such as power-grid frequency regulation and data centers is good and deliveries have reached scale; the company is pushing technical-upgrade expansion and new production lines to prepare for larger demand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (H1 2026 report, risks and responses): the scale and pace of data-center construction carry some uncertainty, so the company will match the pace of coordinated expansion (plant, equipment, materials) to actual demand and balance it against demand from traditional applications. Against global economic and trade uncertainty it will expand domestic sales, use the production base of its Japanese subsidiary AIC to avoid overseas-market risk, and above all push exports of high-tech new products (high-capacitance snap-in aluminum electrolytic, MLPC, supercapacitors, solid-liquid hybrid).

quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (claim): one of the few companies worldwide that develops, makes and sells all three major capacitor types (aluminum electrolytic, film, supercapacitor) for power electronics; its business spans industrial automation, consumer electronics, rail transit, 5G telecom equipment, data centers, server power supplies, new energy and energy storage, electric vehicles, smart grids and defense; it says its industrial capacitors rank among the global leaders in performance and sales volume, and that it makes electrode foil, vacuum-coated films and supercapacitor electrodes in-house, giving the broadest range and most complete industry chain among capacitor makers for power-electronics applications.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nantong Jianghai half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: strategic alliances - with Japanese companies in high-voltage large aluminum electrolytic capacitors, high-performance electrode foil and automotive aluminum electrolytic capacitors; with KEMET in EV film-capacitor modules, automotive axial-lead capacitors and polymer solid aluminum electrolytic capacitors; with the Shanghai Institute of Ceramics (Chinese Academy of Sciences) in supercapacitors; with South China University of Technology in N-type conductive polymers; and a high-end capacitor technology innovation center built with Xi'an Jiaotong University.

Nantong Jianghai.why: Capacitor maker (aluminum electrolytic incl. MLPC / solid-liquid hybrid, film, supercapacitors EDLC / LIC) whose server-power and data-center sales are a stated growth driver; more AI data-center power build-out lifts its capacitor demand.
Nantong Jianghai.evidence: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026): built new fully automatic snap-in aluminum electrolytic lines suited to data centers; supercapacitor demand in data centers and grid frequency regulation is good and deliveries have reached scale.
